versos.e: 1. A son of Hananiah, of the family of David 1Ch 3:21
2. A Simeonite who was captain in an expedition against the Amalekites 1Ch 4:42,43
4. A prince against whom Ezekiel prophesied, and who fell dead at the close of the prophecy Eze 11:1-13
3. One of those who signed the covenant with Nehemiah Ne 10:22
